Card Q&A.q: Does this card's [Your Turn] effect trigger when this card is in the breeding area and would digivolve into a multicolor purple or yellow Digimon card?

Effect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon or any of your Tamers would digivolve into multicolor purple or yellow Digimon cards, reduce the digivolution costs by 1.
Inherited Effect: ＜Retaliation＞ (When only this Digimon is deleted in battle, delete the Digimon it battled.)
